title: Allyson Felix 2016 | Road to Rio | Trans World Sport
description:
Allyson Felix is one of the greatest sprinters of all time. Trans World Sport has filmed with Allyson twice in the past and caught up with her for a third time as she aims for 4 gold medals at the 2016 Rio Olympics.
